title: From pair programmer to executive
description: Concept piece: from one vibe-coding session to administering a virtual company of agents. Grok Bot is the current practical example, not the only future. Distinct from the Grok Bot week-in-review (629b47), Ralph loops (78500a), hill-climb (f10464), and remote-agents (da430a).
